en.title: Give your Agent a new capability.
en.description: Copy this prompt to your Agent. It reads the setup guide and helps install the CLI and Skills.
en.prompt: Read https://cedar-zhang-output.github.io/FindMeGamer/install/README.md and install FindMeGamer CLI and its Skills. Ask me for any missing authorization. Do not run paid research or send email.
en.copiedLabel: Copied. Paste it into your Agent.

en.accessNote: An FMG access token is required. Setup does not start research or send email.
en.compatibilityNote: The current guide targets Codex with terminal and file tools on macOS / Linux. Check compatibility for other Agent hosts.
